# @ferolyte/pack

> TypeScript SDK for writing Minecraft Bedrock add-on content (items, blocks, server/client
> entities, animation controllers, Molang). Used with the `@ferolyte/cli` compiler, which turns
> `export default` builders in `*.item.ts`, `*.block.ts`, `*.se.ts`, `*.ce.ts`, `*.ac.bp.ts`,
> `*.ac.rp.ts` files into pack JSON.

Start with AGENTS.md: file suffix table, rules (camelCase config, MinMaxRange, rawComponents),
a canonical example per content type and how to verify (`ferolyte check --json`, `ferolyte inspect`).

## Entry points

- `@ferolyte/pack`: everything public (`createItem`, `createBlock`, `createServerEntity`,
  `createClientEntity`, `createAnimationController`, `defineRpState`, `defineBpState`, `Molang`, `q`, `not`)
- `@ferolyte/pack/item`, `/block`, `/entity` (server + client), `/molang`, `/animation`: same names, one area
- `@ferolyte/cli/config`: `defineFerolyteConfig`; `@ferolyte/cli/plugin`: `defineFerolytePlugin`

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions, examples and verification workflow
- [README.md](README.md): package overview and the Molang builder
- Types live in the `*.d.ts` files next to each module; component/behavior/filter types are generated from the official
  Bedrock schemas (`content/generated/...`), every field carries its description and `@minecraft <snake_name>`
